author: Blair Marnell
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is under two months away, but the early sales numbers for the game are already starting to get out. According to a sales tracker posted by Sensor Tower, GTA 6's PlayStation 5 presales are outnumbering Xbox Series X|S a ratio of more than 3:1. However, Xbox's Chief Strategy Officer Matthew Ball has refuted a report that Microsoft is unhappy about those sales numbers.

title: Xbox Exec Isn’t Freaking Out Over GTA 6 Presales

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Anyone looking for a creepy adventure to play in November will want to check out Saraab: Beyond the Veil. Solo developer Lubna Ahmed has announced a November 3 release date for the game on PC via Steam and Itch.io, and a demo will be available for it during the October edition of Steam Next Fest.

An Arabian folklore-inspired horror visual-novel game, Saraab follows Elham, a schoolgirl whose brother has suddenly been kidnapped. Rescuing your sibling means confronting your own inner demons, who have been externalized as monsters born of Elham's own psyche. To overcome them, she'll have to unlock the powers of her bloodline and uncover the truth of who she truly is.

title: In Saraab: Beyond The Veil, Your Inner Demons Are Coming For You This November

author: Ben Janca
description: Saraab: Beyond The Veil, a psychological horror visual novel about healing and facing your demons, is coming to PC on Steam on November 3rd, 2026.
title: Saraab: Beyond The Veil – Official Release Date Trailer

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Arc Raiders will soon feature a trial run of Player-versus-Environment (PvE) servers, which would seem to be great news for a player like me, who exclusively plays the game as a PvE experience. 

In actuality, PvE servers ignore one of the game's best traits. 

Embark Studios said that PvE-only servers are coming in a limited testing phase for one week beginning on October 13. Whether they come back after that isn't known yet, not even to the studio itself. Embark cited a player survey that found just over half of respondents (51%) would be interested in PvE servers.

title: I Only Play Arc Raiders As A PvE Game, But PvE Servers Miss The Point

author: Ben Janca
description: Grand Theft Auto 6's protagonists are intertwined. Whether you choose to be in a relationship or not, they are incredibly important to each other's story. Here are the ins and outs of the relationship mechanic and what they could mean as the story progresses.
title: GTA 6 – Jason and Lucia’s Relationship Is Deeper Than You Think

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
Madden, the David O. Russell-directed John Madden biopic starring Nic Cage, got its first full-length trailer today, and to be completely honest, I have no idea what to make of this movie. Based on the two minutes seen in the trailer, it could either be a subversive comedic delight or The Room 2, but with even more footballs and fewer tuxedos.

The trailer, which shows some of John Madden's time as the head coach of the Raiders before shifting to broadcasting, gives us a very good look at the makeup and prosthetics that turned Nic Cage into the most famous NFL broadcaster of all time. Does he look like John Madden? No, but he does look like Nic Cage wearing John Madden's face as his own, so pe
title: First Full Madden Movie Trailer Has Us So Very Confused

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
Zelda fans have had no shortage of new games to play in recent years, but it appears that one game--starring the franchise's iconic villain--was also in the works at one point. Rather than having Nintendo internally develop the game, however, the project was in the works at Ubisoft.

In a September 24 report, Insider Gaming says that Ubisoft Milan was working on a Zelda spin-off with the internal name "Goliath," which was set to star a new protagonist. During the early period of development, this was changed to have longtime big bad Ganondorf be the playable character. Outside of the Super Smash Bros. series, this would be a first and would presumably be quite different from other Zelda games.

However, the repor
title: Nintendo Reportedly Canceled A Ubisoft-Developed Zelda Game Starring Ganondorf

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Punks are taking over Steam starting on October 9 with the Punk Games Showcase, a week-long, curated digital festival celebrating games made with and expressing a punk spirit. 

Over 400 games were submitted for consideration, and the final list includes over 100, with the intention of filtering out any that included generative AI, among other factors. Many featured games have already been released, while others are still to come. A few of them are even out this month or during the event.

I'm still digging through the lengthy list of games that will be featured, but a few that have my heart include:

title: Steam’s Punk Games Showcase Hates AI Slop, Loves Blowing Up Nazis

author: Billy Givens
description:
Arc Raiders developer Embark Studios has officially announced that fans of the popular extraction shooter will soon have a more cooperative-focused way to enjoy exploring topside, as a long-awaited PvE mode will be available to test from October 13-20.

The announcement comes three months after news that Embark was testing a unique PvE map condition on Chinese beta servers. This time around, though, players won't be forced to seek a specific map condition to get their PvE fix. Instead, a new toggle will be available during the week-long test, allowing the choice between standard matchmaking and the PvE mode.

Solos, duos, and trios will all share the same lobbies in PvE mode, as they no longer pose any thr
title: Arc Raiders Is Finally Testing A PvE Mode

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Bungie has big plans to revive not only Destiny 2, but to also evolve its extraction shooter, Marathon. Following its launch in March 2026, the studio says that it has been reviewing feedback around Marathon, and it revealed how it plans to evolve the experience as it heads toward a big update in March 2027.

One of Bungie's major points of focus is a Marathon experience that is more than just an extraction shooter. "PvEvP will remain an important part of Marathon, but it will become one point in a connected set of survival experiences," Bungie wrote<
title: March 2027 Could Be Make-Or-Break For Marathon

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Call of Duty is making major changes to how content carries forward in Warzone, starting with Modern Warfare 4's integration into battle royale. Players will still have access to years' worth of weapons from previous titles, but there will be limitations on how they're used in Warzone.

Operator skins and weapons from Modern Warfare 2, Modern Warfare 3, Black Ops 6, and Black Ops 7 will remain available in Warzone for Season 1, including access to the blueprints and camos players have earned or purchased for them. However, there will be a change to how players get to utilize the older guns in battle royale.
title: Call Of Duty’s Carry Forward Will Continue In Warzone For MW4, But There’s A Catch

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Control Resonant has officially launched, and Remedy Entertainment has also paired it with a fresh patch to make it a little less brutal. Hotfix 1.3.3 is primarily focused on adjusting enemy health pools and Dylan's overall strength, and once it's installed, you can expect the parautilitarian to have an easier time making enemies falter.

"We strongly believe these changes will improve the gameplay feel and flow while still providing a challenge," developer Remedy Entertainment wrote in the hotfix notes. "Depending on player progression, enemies can feel too tanky during the early hours of the game."
title: Control Resonant Is Making Dylan Stronger, Even If He Just Woke Up From A Coma

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Modern Warfare 4 will finally give players control over which skins they see in Call of Duty, starting when the game integrates with Warzone later this year. This will allow players to choose to keep the immersion of Modern Warfare 4 in battle royale, while others can continue to use their outlandish skins from previous seasons. 

The ability to toggle operator skins on and off has been a highly requested feature, especially after Beavis And Butt-Head operators were added in Black Ops 6, but Activision seems to finally be leaning toward player choice. Some players want immersion and thematically appropriate skins, while other players want to use wacky, colorful, and even animal-esque operator skins.
title: Call Of Duty Is Finally Giving Players What They Want

author: Chris Pereira
description:
Control is one of my favorite games ever. Six years after release, one of the things that sticks with me the most is a pencil. 

Within your first few seconds of playing, you happen upon your first memo. It's located at a security checkpoint and outlines a number of items that are not permitted inside the government building you've just entered. These seem expected enough: laptops, weapons, various smart devices, and so on. The final two list items sound much stranger: one being No. 2 pencils. 

It sounds almost like a prank. Certainly, I did not expect any payoff for those words, which are located at the end of one of the many memos that populate The Oldest House, the setting of the game. Here is a giant building in the middle of New York, housing a clandestine government agency responsible for managing the supernatural, and a pencil is a problem for these people?<
title: In Control Resonant, It’s The Tiniest Details That Continue To Matter Most

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
RGG Studio's Stranger Than Heaven is certainly living up to its title, as the decision to resurrect the late rapper Tupac Shakur as a character in the game was perceived as odd when it was first announced at Summer Game Fest. In a new update on the game, RGG Studio revealed more details about the game's cast, including a brief description of how it revived Shakur using traditional research methods. The main takeaway is that the Yakuza and Like a Dragon developer managed to avoid making the casting more controversial by confirming that no artificial intelligence technology was used.

"RGG Studio is treating this integration with the utmost respect for his legacy, crafting every aspect in close collaboration and without the use of AI, including his chara
title: Stranger Than Heaven Studio Made The Tupac Resurrection Less Weird By Not Using AI

author: Tauriq Moosa
description:
In preparation for Remedy’s upcoming third-person action-adventure Control Resonant, I began my third or fourth replay of its predecessor. 

Despite my love for the original Control, with its floating workers and teleporting rubber ducks, I eyerolled at the idea of tackling one particularly large boss–it’s a giant anchor that shoots clocks and I refuse to elaborate. 

However, Remedy added a slew of accessibility options post-launch that have made Control more comfortable for more people. One of these was an "Immortality" toggle that, as the name suggests, prevents the player character dying while leaving all other elements of the game as is. After this last session with Control, I want to propose the following: Every single-player game with combat (barring some exceptions) should have this Immortality toggle.

Turning on Immortality allow
title: Put Remedy’s Immortality Toggle In All Games

It'll launch on November 19, the same day as GTA 6.

Here's a closer look at what $400 gets you:

The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection contents

description:
One of the earliest Silent Hill: Townfall puzzles that's likely to stump you is in the pharmacy. Simon needs a locker code to continue the story, but the answer is hidden behind some rather obtuse clues--the kind this series made its name on, frankly.

Here's what you need to do to solve the Townfall pharmacy puzzle and get the locker code.

Standing inside the pharmacy, Simon will be met with a tall locker that needs a four-digit code. It won't likely be obvious, but what you need to do is refer to your CRTV. title: Silent Hill: Townfall’s Pharmacy Locker Code Will Be The First Puzzle To Stump You

author: Steve Watts
description:
Duskfade passed by last month without too much notice. To the extent that it gained attention, it was for its Nomura-like character design that appeared to be aping Kingdom Hearts. And while that isn't inaccurate, it also feels like an unfair simplification. Duskfade is very little like Kingdom Hearts, more reminiscent of a PS3-era action-platformer than an action-RPG. Its gameplay is composed mostly of really satisfying platforming with occasional, merely so-so combat encounters. But what really resonated with me most was its story, which for all of its storybook-like simplicity, had impactful moments that utilized boss fights like nothing else I've seen.

Spoilers follow.

Duskfade takes place in a fantasy world where Clockmakers are essentially steampunk wizards. You play as Zirian, the young hero on a quest to find his big sister, Allira. After your grandfather, t
title: Duskfade Makes Boss Fights Feel Poignant

author: Callum Self
description:
There’s something about a spine-tingling atmosphere and the fear of being scared that draws me into playing horror games. There’s something captivating about removing the power fantasy some video games have and putting you into a more vulnerable, hunted situation, and Silent Hill’s tension makes those frightening shenanigans even more terrifying. When I saw Silent Hill: Townfall was changing the formula by Resident Evil 7-ing the franchise, I was intrigued, and now I can wholeheartedly recommend it. Best of all, you can get a Steam key for cheap at launch.

Despite the first-person perspective giving me the aforementioned RE7 vibes, playing Silent Hill: Townfall is a lot closer to Alien: Isolation or Outlast—which, thankfully, are some of my favorite horror games of all time. Set in 1996, you play as Simon Ordell, who finds himself in the fog-covered Sco
title: Silent Hill: Townfall Is The Franchise’s Answer To Alien: Isolation, And It’s Already On Sale

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Xbox Achievements have remained mostly the same since they were first introduced decades ago, but it looks like they're set to evolve slightly with the introduction of "Mythic" Achievements. Similar to PlayStation's platinum trophies, it looks like players will have to earn every Achievement in a game before they're awarded one of these. How do you know if you've earned this rare level of kudos on your PC or Xbox? Don't worry, unlocking a Mythic Achievement will result in your system rewarding you with a lot of digital fanfare.

As spotted by Klobrille, unlocking a Mythic Achievement will trigger a lengthy animation and sound effect, running almost 15 seconds in total:

title: Xbox’s New Mythic Achievements Take 15 Seconds To Tell You “Good Job”

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
For years, Meta has had one of the best entry-level virtual reality headsets with the Quest 3 and its slightly lower-specced successor, the Quest 3S. The VR hardware packs a punch, but if you're looking for an even lighter option, the company's new VR glasses could catch your attention. Essentially a Quest 3 that's designed to be easier to carry around, the Meta VR Glasses also come equipped with some impressive screens--and a massive price tag of $1,300 when they launch in Spring 2027.

According to Meta, the VR Glasses weigh just 100 grams, thanks to a pocket-sized puck that is tethered to the specs. This unit houses all the tech for running apps and games on the VR Glasses, and inside you'll find a Qualcomm Snapdragon Reality Elite chipset, 128GB of storage, 12GB of RAM, and a battery. The glasses feature 5K Micro OLED lenses, which can output 2412 x 2288 pixels per eye at a 120Hz refresh rate.
title: Meta’s $1,300 VR Glasses Could Be The Most Expensive Way To Play Xbox Games
